name: Blood Machines
description: Blood Machines is a Minecraft Tech Mod that is heavily inspired by Ultrakill; the machines in the mod run on the blood you collect from your enemies. (Note at time of writing the mod hasn't gotten this far.)
contribution: Largest acomplishment from this mod is a type tree that functions like the trees in Ultrakill's 7-3.
notes: While I haven't worked on it in a long while I do plan on coming back to this one; Minecraft and Ultrkill are two of my favorite games, which has carried the spark of passion for this project several months past when I stopped working on it.

I am not exaggerating when I say Modding Minecraft is THE MOST TECHNICALLY CHALLANGING THING I have EVER done. Something as simple as adding a normal ass block took what felt like my entire academic and personal education to comprehend; let alone implement. (I made this with Forge if you're curios; can't speak on Fabric).
